_comment: Sentinel-1 event definitions (V2). Windows are PROPOSALS to be checked with scripts/s1_availability.py. 'peak' = approximate date of heaviest flooding; verify against official sources before relying on it.

events.name: Chennai floods 2015 - November wave (S1 evidence: 12 Nov 2015 per UNOSAT)
events.notes: Peak flooding was 1-2 Dec 2015; Sentinel-1 evidence found only for 12 Nov 2015. Single satellite (S1A) in 2015.
events.scene_ids_source: ASF catalogue + Earth Engine COPERNICUS/S1_GRD exact system:index match, verified live on the user's Windows machine (outputs/tables/s1_gee_availability_2015_nov.csv)

events.name: Chennai floods 2015 - December peak
events.notes: Public flood products for the Dec peak used ALOS-2 (3 Dec) not Sentinel-1; S1 coverage UNKNOWN until probed.

events.name: Chennai floods Nov 2021
events.notes: Sentinel-Asia lists a Sentinel-1 product of 16 Nov 2021 (MBRSC) and ALOS-2 products of 8 and 12 Nov 2021 (independent L-band cross-check).

events.name: Cyclone Michaung Dec 2023
events.notes: Only Sentinel-1A operated in 2023 (12-day repeat per orbit): a pass within days of 4-5 Dec is NOT guaranteed. NRSC RISAT-1A map of 7 Dec 2023 and EOS-04 7 Dec scene exist as comparison products.

s1b_params._comment: S1B (V2.2) parameters. Starting values from the SAR flood-mapping literature, NOT tuned for Chennai and NOT validated. Override on the command line with --set name=value; every run records its parameters and a hash.
